exposure: FIGO-2015 pathologic intrapartum cardiotocography requiring expedited delivery (CTG_RED)
outcome: umbilical cord metabolic acidemia at birth (MA; pH < 7.0 and/or BE <= - 12 mmol/L)
cohort: The study included 3459 pregnancies experiencing the 2nd stage of labor and delivering at IRCCS Sant'Orsola-Malpighi Hospital in Bologna, Italy, between 2018 and 2019.
finding: The risk for umbilical cord metabolic acidemia at birth increases with the duration of the second stage of labor, quadrupling in the presence of pathological intrapartum cardiotocography requiring expedited delivery, with nulliparity and meconium-stained amniotic fluid also being significant predictors.
mod_finding: Expedited operative delivery or urgent cesarean section was required in 8.20% of cases experiencing pathological intrapartum cardiotocography.
